items.hypothesis: TP-B1 P1 slot 1 after C07: MODEL on the live clock; primary = public views at 48 h.
items.caption:
Jump in Spain. When do you pop out in New Zealand?
38 min 11 s, and you stop exactly at the surface. A model of a tunnel through Earth with its real density (Klotz, arXiv 2013).
AI-made animation by Studia.
